saturdays.title: Wildwood — vertical build
saturdays.desc: Week 1 of the Saturday progression. In-town, smooth tread.

saturdays.title: Angels Rest → Devil's Rest loop
saturdays.desc: 10.7 mi, Columbia River Gorge. Talus and exposed switchbacks. No timed-use permit in 2026. Objective is the descent, not the summit — watch the descent HR gap.

saturdays.title: Table Mountain
saturdays.desc: 8.4 mi from Bonneville. Heartbreak Ridge drops 700 ft in half a mile on loose talus — the quad-wrecker rehearsal. Steep meadow exposure near the summit.

saturdays.title: Three Sisters Loop
saturdays.desc: First real overnight and multi-day exposure — a good spot to try a short deliberate sleep stop.

saturdays.title: Down week — Wildwood
saturdays.desc: Recovery from Three Sisters. Deliberately easy.

saturdays.title: COURSE RECON — Norway Pass → Mount Margaret
saturdays.desc: 11 mi out-and-back, high point 5,780 ft. This is Bigfoot course miles 56 back toward 37, and Mount Margaret is the HIGH POINT OF THE RACE. Manual: 'Best views of the course, recommend running in daylight if possible.' NW Forest Pass or $5 day-use; no backcountry permit for day hiking. Water at Bear Camp (mi 4.1) is unreliable late season — carry it. No dogs. Do it while FR 99 is open; it closes with snow. Mid-October is late for this — FR 99 and the Norway Pass trailhead close with snow. Check msh institute conditions the week before; if the road is shut, fall back to Table Mountain and take the recon as lost until 2027.

saturdays.title: Elk Mountain / Kings Mountain traverse
saturdays.desc: 10.9 mi, Tillamook State Forest. Exposed narrow ridge with scrambling and a fixed rope — closest thing in Block 1 to Blue Lake → Coldwater Lake. Elk Mtn climbs 2,080 ft in 1.5 mi.

saturdays.title: Mount Defiance
saturdays.desc: 11.6 mi, the hardest day hike in the region — 3,000 ft in three miles. Biggest day of the block. Late in its season at 4,959 ft: if there's snow up high, swap to Nesmith Point (~3,800 ft).

saturdays.title: Taper into Run the Rock 50K
saturdays.desc: Short and easy. Race target: 3.2 mph, finish upright.

saturdays.title: Dog Mountain
saturdays.desc: Steep and relentless. Permit is spring weekends only — free in November. First night-hours sessions should be landing this month too.

saturdays.title: Elk / Kings — BENCHMARK REPEAT
saturdays.desc: Same course as Oct 24, six weeks later. This is a measurement, not a workout: compare time, descent HR gap, and how the last hour felt. It tells you whether Block 1 worked.

saturdays.title: Table Mountain
saturdays.desc: Last long day before the checkpoint. Keep it controlled.

saturdays.title: Frozen Trail Run Fest 50K
saturdays.desc: Block 1 checkpoint. Block question: can you sustain a full day on feet and descend hard without wrecking your quads?
